title: Facial Recognition & Biometric Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template letter to request removal of biometric data and opt-out of facial recognition systems. Protect your privacy from unauthorized scanning.
description: A comprehensive letter template to formally request the deletion of your biometric data from facial recognition databases and opt-out of future scanning. Includes specific language for different types of organizations and legal requirements.

sections.heading: Letter Header & Contact Information
sections.content: Start your privacy request with proper formatting and contact details to ensure your letter reaches the right department and receives proper attention.

sections.heading: Subject Line & Opening Statement
sections.content:
Clearly state your purpose and establish your right to privacy under applicable laws. Reference specific legislation like BIPA, CCPA, or GDPR where applicable.

Subject: Formal Request for Biometric Data Deletion and Facial Recognition Opt-Out

Dear Privacy Officer or Data Protection Officer,

I am writing to formally request the immediate deletion of any biometric data, facial recognition templates, or related identifiers that your organization may have collected, processed, or stored about me without my explicit consent.

sections.heading: Specific Data Deletion Requests
sections.content:
I specifically request the deletion of the following biometric information:

• Facial recognition templates or mathematical representations of my face
• Biometric identifiers derived from photographs or video footage
• Any geolocation data associated with facial recognition detection
• Metadata linking my identity to biometric profiles
• Third-party data obtained from sources like Clearview AI or similar databases

This request applies to all data collected through security cameras, mobile applications, social media scraping, or any other means of biometric data collection.

placeholders.label: Specific Locations/Services
placeholders.defaultValue: [Specify locations, apps, or services where scanning may have occurred]

sections.heading: Legal Basis for Request
sections.content:
This request is made under my rights provided by applicable privacy laws including but not limited to:

• The right to deletion/erasure of personal data
• The right to withdraw consent for biometric data processing
• The right to object to automated decision-making and profiling
• Protection against unauthorized biometric data collection under state biometric privacy laws

I have not provided explicit, informed consent for the collection or processing of my biometric information for facial recognition purposes.

placeholders.label: Specific State Law
placeholders.defaultValue: [Illinois BIPA/Texas Capture or Use of Biometric Identifier Act/etc.]

sections.heading: Opt-Out of Future Collection
sections.content:
In addition to requesting deletion of existing data, I formally opt-out of any future biometric data collection, facial recognition scanning, or related processing activities. Please:

• Add my information to your biometric data opt-out registry
• Implement technical measures to prevent future scanning of my biometric features
• Ensure third-party vendors and contractors respect this opt-out request
• Provide alternative access methods that do not require biometric data

I do not consent to the sharing, sale, or transfer of any biometric data to third parties, including law enforcement, unless legally compelled by warrant.

sections.heading: Response Requirements & Timeline
sections.content:
Please provide written confirmation within 30 days that includes:

• Acknowledgment of this request and confirmation of data deletion
• Description of what biometric data was held and how it was obtained
• Confirmation that data has been deleted from all systems, backups, and third-party processors
• Details about your facial recognition opt-out process
• Contact information for future privacy-related inquiries

If you cannot fulfill this request, please provide a detailed legal explanation citing specific statutory authority.

sections.heading: Closing & Signature
sections.content:
I trust you will handle this matter promptly and in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Failure to respond appropriately may result in complaints to relevant regulatory authorities and consideration of legal action.

Thank you for your attention to this important privacy matter.

Sincerely,

[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
[Your Contact Information]
